title: "Spatial Data in R"
format: html

## Read the Zarr file

```{r}
library(SpatialData)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(SpatialFeatureExperiment)
library(scater)
library(Voyager)

spd <- readSpatialData("c26t16_align.zarr/")
spd
```

## Plot data

Note that the images have been aligned using landmarks and affine transformation.

```{r}
ps <- list(
    p1 <- plotImage(spd, i=2, coord = "aligned"), 
    p2 <- plotShape(spd, fill="grey"))
wrap_plots(ps)
pile(ps)
```

## Extract features

```{r}
(sce <- mask(image(spd, i="C26T16_GFP"), shape(spd)))
assay(sce)[,1:4]
```

Here, we sum all three channels. And plot the spots color-coded by the total GFP intensities.

```{r}
tmp = spd$tables[[1]]
colData(tmp)$gfp <- colSums(assay(sce))
colData(tmp)

as.data.frame(colData(tmp)) |>
    ggplot(aes(-array_row, -array_col, color = log(gfp))) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_viridis_c()
```

Now we can create and save a SpatialFeatureExperiment object with this information.

```{r}
base_dirs <- "~/Google Drive/My Drive/research/Cachectic_Visium/"
sample_dirs <- c("Sample_S54409_C26Sh_16_18_20")

sfe <- read10xVisiumSFE(samples = paste0(base_dirs, sample_dirs), 
                        type = "sparse",
                        data = "filtered", 
                        images = "lowres",
                        sample_id = "C26T16", zero.policy=TRUE)

sfe <- mirror(sfe)
colData(sfe)$gfp <- colSums(assay(sce))
sfe <- logNormCounts(sfe)
rownames(sfe) <- rowData(sfe)$symbol

sfe_all <- readRDS("sfe_annotated.rds")
sample_id <- sfe_all$sample_id[sfe_all$in_tissue]
tissue_id <- sfe_all$tissue_id[sfe_all$in_tissue]
tissue_id <- droplevels(tissue_id[sample_id == "C26T16"])

plotSpatialFeature(sfe, "gfp")
plotSpatialFeature(sfe, "Trim63")
```

# Differential expression

```{r}
plotColData(sfe, "gfp")
hist(log(sfe$gfp))
summary(sfe$gfp)

sfe$gfp_bin <- as.factor(ifelse(sfe$gfp > 20, 1, 0))
plotSpatialFeature(sfe, "gfp_bin")

sfe <- sfe[!grepl("^DEPRECATED", rownames(sfe)),]

library(edgeR)
y <- DGEList(counts=counts(sfe), group=sfe$gfp_bin)
y <- y[,!is.na(tissue_id)]
filter <- filterByExpr(y, min.count = 1, min.prop = 0.3)
table(filter)
markers <- c("Trim63", "Foxo1", "Foxo3")
markers %in% rownames(sfe)[filter]

y <- y[filter,]
y <- calcNormFactors(y)
design <- model.matrix(~sfe$gfp_bin + tissue_id)
y <- estimateDisp(y,design)

fit <- glmFit(y,design)
lrt <- glmLRT(fit,coef=2)
topTags(lrt)

top <- topTags(lrt, n=Inf)$table

write.table(top, file = "c26_treated_GFPvsBlack.tsv", sep = "\t",      
            row.names = TRUE, col.names = TRUE)

table(top$FDR <= 0.05)

top[markers,]
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| eval: false
#| include: false
library(spatialreg)
colGraph(sfe, "visium") <- findVisiumGraph(sfe, zero.policy = TRUE)
Trim63 <- logcounts(sfe)["Trim63",]
gfp <- sfe$gfp
fit.err<-errorsarlm(Trim63 ~ log(gfp), listw = colGraph(sfe, "visium"), zero.policy=TRUE) 
summary(fit.err)

fit.lag<-lagsarlm(Trim63 ~ log(gfp), listw = colGraph(sfe, "visium"), zero.policy=TRUE)
summary(fit.lag)
```
